title: Ban the Generated-with-Claude-Code credit from commits, PRs and comments
body:
Widens the existing "no AI attribution" rule in `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md`.

Before: no `Co-Authored-By: Claude` / `Claude-Session` trailer on commits.

After: additionally, no `🤖 Generated with Claude Code` line — or any other "generated by" / tool credit — in a commit message, a PR title or description, or a PR / code-review comment. Commits are subject + body only; PRs and comments are plain prose.

Both files edited together (they are the same file per their own header). Note: this PR description follows the new rule.
